edge_execution_flow.includes: real worker execution, JSON validation, conflict preservation, inherited limits, Chinese and English mobile views

coverage: Eight concurrent claim attempts admit exactly three jobs in three eligible projects
A capped project does not block another project; AI queue capacity remains independent
Zero admission leaves active leases renewable; expired work recovers with a new generation
Lowering admission to zero during a real simulation preserves final Core state hash
Initialization is idempotent across processes with different startup defaults
Strict numeric and unknown-field validation, optimistic revision checks and history rollback
Administrator queue management does not grant access to another project's model data
Ordinary members cannot edit limits or view foreign queue counts; server mutations require CSRF
Search treats percent and underscore literally and pages without overlap
Worker drain is audited, missing worker rejected, active lease retained
Browser validates real queued-to-completed transition, unsaved conflict draft and explicit reload
Mobile table readability corrected through screenshot inspection; responsive queue cards and translations verified
limits: Concurrency budgets are not OS CPU, memory or disk quotas
No strict fair-share reservation or automatic worker process scaling
Old workers that do not consult central limits must be stopped before upgrade
The full 308-case run preceded the additional search and API assertions; those passed in the final targeted runs
No new database service or MQ, no model format changes and no data directory scan
